title: Bootstrap confidence interval
code_simulate:
set.seed(240507)
d <- data.frame(colony=1:40, biomass_mg=rlnorm(40, log(12), .45))
write.csv(d, file.path(out_dir, "data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
code_plot:
stripchart(d$biomass_mg, method="stack", pch=21, bg="#146A85",
           xlab="Colony biomass (mg)", main="Independent bacterial colonies")
abline(v=mean(d$biomass_mg), col="#C56B3B", lwd=2)
code_analysis:
B <- 4999
boot_mean <- numeric(B)
for (i in 1:B) boot_mean[i] <- mean(sample(d$biomass_mg, replace=TRUE))
ci <- quantile(boot_mean, c(.025,.975))
result <- data.frame(mean=mean(d$biomass_mg), lower=ci[1], upper=ci[2])
biology: Estimate average biomass from independent bacterial colonies with a right-skewed distribution.
design: One biomass measurement per independent colony.
question: How uncertain is the estimated mean biomass?
null: No null is required for this confidence interval; the target is the population mean.
options: Resample entire independent units with replacement.
Choose statistic, B and interval method explicitly.
Percentile is illustrated; it is not universally the best bootstrap interval.
assumptions: The sample represents the population of interest.
Rows are independent units; cluster resampling is needed for clustered data.
Small or unrepresentative samples limit bootstrap performance.
parametric: Use a suitable response model or a t interval when appropriate.
nonparametric: Resample independent colonies; resample clusters or pairs intact when needed.
generating_model: 40 independent Lognormal(meanlog=log(12), sdlog=0.45) colony biomasses. The generating arithmetic mean is exp(log(12)+0.45^2/2), approximately 13.28 mg.
generating_truth: The population arithmetic mean is approximately 13.28 mg; the interval may or may not cover it in one sample.
teaching_point: Resampling changes the computational procedure, not what counts as an independent replicate.

plot_args.note: Stacks nearby observations without hiding them

practice: Would resampling individual cells be appropriate if biomass was measured on whole colonies?
